_: Globetrotteren in English: Globetrotter (guess the country). Distances are in miles in the British edition. Country names live in data.en/land.json.
Hvilket land er dette? Du ser omrisset (: Which country is this? You see its outline (or its flag) and have six tries.
Skriv de første bokstavene og velg lande: Type the first few letters and pick the country from the list.
Etter hvert gjett ser du hvor langt det: After every guess you see how far it is from your country to the right one, an arrow pointing towards it, and how close you are in per cent.
Finner du landet på seks forsøk, har du: Find the country in six tries and you've done it. Today's country is the same for everyone.
Avstanden måles mellom midten av landene: The distance is measured between the middles of the countries, and the arrow shows the direction from the country you guessed.
Står du fast, kan hintet fortelle hvilke: Stuck? The hint tells you which continent the country is in.
Omrisset viser fastlandet og øyene rundt: The outline shows the mainland and the islands around it – not territories far away.
Fritt spill kan også vise flagg i stedet: Free play can show flags instead of outlines too.
Kartdata fra Natural Earth (fritt tilgje: Map data from Natural Earth (public domain). The flags are drawn for rusj, with simplified coats of arms.
Samme land for alle i dag: The same country for everyone today
Distance and direction show the way.
Hva vil du gjette ut fra?: What do you want to guess from?
Free play gives a new country every time. Today's country is always an outline.
Forslagene kommer under feltet. Pil ned: Suggestions appear below the field. Arrow down to choose.

Du fant det på {n} av {maks} forsøk..one: You found it in {n} of {maks} tries.
Du fant det på {n} av {maks} forsøk..other: You found it in {n} of {maks} tries.

Now you'll know it next time.
